papers.title: Bilingualism and cognitive control in middle adulthood: a systematic review protocol
papers.reason: This protocol is centrally about human cognitive control in middle adulthood, but it is a planned evidence synthesis rather than a report of new behavioural or neural findings.

papers.title: Physical Fitness, Visuospatial Working Memory, and Task-Related Hemodynamic Responses in Preschool Children: A Cross-Sectional fNIRS Study
papers.reason: The study reports human behavioural and fNIRS findings linking visuospatial working memory performance to prefrontal and visual cortical activation.

papers.title: Retrieval practice is associated with attenuated stress-related inference impairment and stronger reactivation of bridge-related category information
papers.reason: The paper provides behavioural and EEG evidence on stress, memory-based inference, and cognitive flexibility, with neural reactivation signals that could inform process models.

papers.title: Correction: Multimodal EEG and explainable machine learning characterize neuroticism-related neurodynamic heterogeneity in mild cognitive impairment during visuospatial working memory
papers.reason: This appears to be a correction notice rather than a substantive report, despite referring to a highly relevant EEG and working-memory study in MCI.

papers.title: The role of the right temporal lobe in neural network mechanisms during working memory encoding
papers.reason: The paper directly reports task-based EEG oscillation and connectivity findings during visual working-memory encoding in epilepsy patients and controls.

papers.title: Early-life ethanol exposure alters the splicing of microexons in the rat brain
papers.reason: The work concerns animal molecular mechanisms relevant to a disorder involving executive deficits, but it does not measure executive function, attention, or working-memory behaviour directly.

papers.title: The aging human brain exhibits reduced hemodynamic and cerebrospinal fluid flow waves during sleep.
papers.reason: The study addresses human brain aging, sleep physiology, and neurodegeneration risk, but it has no specific focus on executive function, working memory, attention, or cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Technology-Assisted Cognitive Rehabilitation in Parkinson’s Disease: A Systematic Review of Cognitive, Psychological, and Implementation Outcomes
papers.reason: The review covers technology-assisted cognitive rehabilitation in Parkinson’s disease, including executive and planning outcomes, but it is about intervention evidence rather than modelling or biomarker development.

papers.title: Processing speed accounts for the discriminative power of a brief smartphone Go/No-Go task among individuals with multiple sclerosis
papers.reason: The study evaluates a smartphone Go/No-Go behavioural task as a digital biomarker for clinical group discrimination in multiple sclerosis.

papers.title: Survival analysis of spontaneous speech for predicting mild cognitive impairment-to-dementia conversion
papers.reason: The paper develops speech-derived digital biomarkers for prognosis of MCI-to-dementia conversion, with semantic verbal fluency providing a clinically relevant cognitive assessment signal.
